<thought>To construct a single‑step retrosynthetic disconnection, I will look for a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the carbonyl‑ene reaction described in the prompt. In the forward direction this template converts a ketone and an alkene into a five‑membered ring bearing an allylic alcohol (the target molecule). Therefore, in the retro direction the target is split into a ketone fragment and an alkene fragment, breaking the C–O bond of the alcohol and the newly formed C–C bond, and forming a C=O double bond and a C=C double bond. I will search the template catalog for such a transformation and then use the identified template to build the required JSON route.
